sanskrit_verse: अनियुक्ता तु या नारी देवराज् जनयेत् सुतम् । जारजातम् अरिक्थीयं तम् आहुर् धर्मवादिनः ॥
transliteration: aniyuktaa tu yaa naarii devaraa j janayet sutam | jaarajaatam arikthiiya.m tam aahur dharmavaadina.h ||
sph_interpretive_translation: A woman who, without formal union, bears a child through union with a divine being, produces offspring known as Arikthi. Such progeny is recognized by those established in Dharma.
